data.long_meaning: Liena is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lila' meaning 'play' or 'pastime'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus flower is a symbol of purity, divinity, and enlightenment. The name Liena reflects the divine and spiritual essence of the lotus. The name Liena carries the meaning “Lotus flower” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Liena usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
